The stronger matched-seed replication rejected the claimed reliable dose boundary; earlier dose-specific results remain historical but do not establish a universal critical anchor probability.

The 10% confirmatory replication produced 10/12 individually reliable exact-C4 seeds and large control margins, but failed the preregistered aggregate reliability requirements. This is a scientific negative result, not an infrastructure failure.

current_conclusion: Evidence supports a real synthetic structured-mechanism advantage on many seeds and some dose-specific successes, but reliability is seed-sensitive and the stronger confirmatory evidence does not support a robust universal anchor-dose threshold or an unconditional 10% reliability claim.
